note: App side only (Makine-LauncherPlugin-Live spec/): a line whose OCR box touches the capture region's edge was cut by the region. margin = max(2, round(0.01 * region width)) px; a box touches the left edge when x0 <= margin, the right when x1 >= width - margin, the top when y0 <= margin, the bottom when y1 >= height - margin. The text test is the server's (src/live/text.ts lineIssues / isEnglishWord): a touching line is cut only when its edge word is not a word (left) or it has no closing punctuation and the last word is not a word (right). Top/bottom contact = a wrapped subtitle's other line is outside the region. A cut line is not sent; the region grows on that side (widen: 10% of its width/height, within the screen) and the next frame is read again.
